findings: Owner request 2026-11-10: practice long questions for Unit 2 in the same format as the other books' chapter practice, long questions in the Mathematics Board Section-II shape (5-mark parts) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the unit; not printed in the book. 24 questions numbered 1-24; by section: 2.2 1, 2.4 1, 2.5 1, 2.6 1, 2.7 3, 2.8 3, 2.9.2 1, 2.10.3 2, 2.10.4 2, 2.11.1 2, 2.12.1 1, 2.13 2, 2.14 4.

24 five-mark questions: the unit's derivations (d/dx cos x by definition, d/dx a^x and d/dx log_a x by definition, d/dx csc^-1 x with |x|) and its main problem types (parametric second derivative, implicit tangent and normal, higher-derivative relations, tangents and normals, increasing/decreasing intervals, Second Derivative Test, global extrema on closed intervals, linearization, differentials and errors, real-world optimization) with new data. Book corrections followed ((csc x)' = -csc x cot x, d/dx csc^-1 x = -1/(|x| sqrt(x^2 - 1)), 'inconclusive', angles in radians). Every step was checked by computation (sympy, check2.py).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
